title: Zombie Apocalypse: Survival Frontier
description: Zombie Apocalypse Modpack that add a bunch of stuffs
body:
Zombie Apocalypse: Survival Frontier

Zombie Apocalypse: Survival Frontier throws you into a world overrun by the undead, where survival is your only goal. Cities lie in ruins, dangerous structures hide powerful loot, and hordes of zombies roam both day and night. Every step outside your base is a risk, and every bullet counts.

Arm yourself with a wide variety of guns, melee weapons, and tactical gear to fight back against relentless zombie threats. Face special infected, tougher boss mobs, and unpredictable encounters that keep combat intense and immersive. Ammo management, weapon upgrades, and strategic positioning are key to staying alive.

Explore a massive, ruined world filled with abandoned cities, military bases, bunkers, labs, and survivor camps. Scavenge for supplies, uncover secrets, and slowly rebuild in a hostile environment. With a strong focus on exploration, adventure, and survival, this modpack is designed to deliver a true zombie apocalypse experience.
